<STBG 3,0><BGM 0,0,502><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 5,1,5,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,2,0><CV 1,5>Dr. Hawk!
We found a firefly we've never seen,
so we came to report!

<CHAR 1,0,1,1,0>This firefly...
it glows a rare colour, purple...

<TALK 5><NAME 10>Ah, the colour changed.
It seems to have many colours.

One might call it the Seven-Colour Fly...
Anyway, this is a new discovery!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CV 1,10><CHAR 1,0,1,3,0>You did it, Hunter!
A huge discovery!
